verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at api-dashboard.search.brave.com/llms.txt describing the API. The docs are published as agent-readable markdown pages (index.html.md URLs for services and the API reference), and a Skills resource targets coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe 404'd), and no independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
